items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he was the studio every time Pops made a record.

ctx.x: Now, in the discography, it's mentioned that Eddie Condon was on banjo and Lonnie Johnson was on guitar on this "I Can't Give You Anything But Love" session. Do you remember Eddie Condon being there?

Yeah, he was... Well, he was in the studio every time Pops was. He was in the studio. You know what I mean? Yeah, he was the studio every time Pops made a record. Not only him, all his boys. Oh, there was a bunch of them. Mezz Mezzrow, you know, the Reefer King? Yeah, he was there. All them boys. They used to follow him around
